tafsir_editions.finding: The catalogue lists author, name, language and the site each text was taken from (quran.com, qul.tarteel.ai or altafsir.com). It states no licence, publisher, editor, translator or year for any edition.

hadith_graders.finding: Each grade names a grader but no printed work, edition or page. The upstream References.md says the grades come from scans of printed editions on al-maktaba.org (and one archive.org item); the repository's Unlicense covers its own files, not the graders' published gradings.
